beta.notes:
New in this version:
• Schoology pre-grading now remembers items that need review and automatically rechecks them when assignment material changes.

Fixes:
• Fixed Google Docs directions sometimes appearing unreadable to pre-grading; Work Sample Buddy can now use available assignment descriptions when no rubric is attached.
• Fixed resubmission badges appearing on ordinary reopened work or lingering after a newer Schoology grade. The R badge now marks only a true resubmission and follows its current grading state.
• Fixed queued Schoology pre-grading and progress totals being lost or repeatedly refreshed while the class grid reloads.

stable.notes:
New in this version:
• Missing Schoology work now offers a direct assignment link and a Reload action in the center of the viewer.
• Reload checks Schoology again and downloads newly submitted work automatically.

Fixes:
• Fixed course-card clicks opening a different student's course or assignment. The selected student and course now stay together through grading.
• Fixed missing-assignment links sending signed-in teachers to the generic Schoology login page.
